Retail & Services.market_opportunity: Good potential where the business solves a daily local need and offers reliable service.
Retail & Services.competitor_density: Moderate; differentiate through service quality, delivery and digital visibility.
Retail & Services.season_tip: festival offers, local demand tracking and inventory discipline
Retail & Services.pricing: Use cost-plus pricing, but benchmark against 3–5 nearby alternatives.
Retail & Services.market_reach: Taluk centre, nearby villages and digital/local delivery radius.
Retail & Services.scheme: Eligible financing depends on business type and current official scheme/lender rules

Food Processing.market_opportunity: Strong when local raw materials can be converted into consistent, branded products.
Food Processing.competitor_density: Low to moderate in specialized local products; distribution quality matters.
Food Processing.season_tip: raw-material availability, hygiene and shelf-life planning
Food Processing.pricing: Calculate raw material + packaging + labour + distribution before setting margins.
Food Processing.market_reach: Retail stores, weekly markets, online/local resellers.
Food Processing.scheme: Check MSME, food-processing and lender options currently available

Agriculture & Allied.market_opportunity: Potential is linked to local crop patterns, irrigation, livestock and aggregation access.
Agriculture & Allied.competitor_density: Varies by taluk and existing farm enterprises.
Agriculture & Allied.season_tip: crop calendar, monsoon dependence and harvest demand
Agriculture & Allied.pricing: Use seasonal packages and calculate maintenance/logistics costs carefully.
Agriculture & Allied.market_reach: Village clusters, FPOs, markets and taluk buyers.
Agriculture & Allied.scheme: Verify agriculture/allied-sector finance with authorized institutions

Tourism & Hospitality.market_opportunity: High in destination and transit areas when service quality and discoverability are strong.
Tourism & Hospitality.competitor_density: Moderate to high in popular destinations.
Tourism & Hospitality.season_tip: peak-season pricing, reviews and advance booking
Tourism & Hospitality.pricing: Use weekday/weekend and peak/off-peak pricing bands.
Tourism & Hospitality.market_reach: Tourists, travel partners and online listings.

Beauty & Personal Care.market_opportunity: Promising in dense residential and town markets with differentiated service.
Beauty & Personal Care.competitor_density: Moderate to high; customer experience is important.
Beauty & Personal Care.season_tip: festival packages, wedding demand and repeat memberships
Beauty & Personal Care.pricing: Bundle services and protect margins instead of competing only on the lowest price.
Beauty & Personal Care.market_reach: Nearby residential areas, colleges and social media audience.

Manufacturing & Handicrafts.market_opportunity: Good where skills, raw materials and reliable buyers can be connected.
Manufacturing & Handicrafts.pricing: Include wastage, labour, overhead and distribution in unit economics.
Manufacturing & Handicrafts.market_reach: Retail, wholesalers, B2B and online markets.
